Job Description




Role : AI Engineer

Location - Pune
Experience - 8 - 10 years


Key Responsibilities

Build the agent's grounded RAG pipeline on Bedrock Knowledge Bases, including prompt/instruction engineering and response grounding with citations
Implement Bedrock Guardrails enforcement for read-only scope restriction and PII redaction, and integrate the agent with its chat channel
Curate and help build the internal library of reusable MCP servers and connectors (Library & MCP Servers) and the Loom pattern/prompt library packaged for the IDE
Design and build the Context Serving API's agent-facing integration and configure agent-specific memory strategies on top of platform Memory
Build all five R3.0 quick-follow agents (Invoice & AP, Learning & Development, Contract Lifecycle, Store Task Orchestration, Indirect Spend) by reusing the proven orchestration pattern, wiring each into Context Serving, its Domain Graph and the Retail Ontology rather than building bespoke integrations
Run each new agent through the shared Evaluation framework instead of building a bespoke test harness per agent

Required Qualifications

7-10 years in AI, with hands-on experience building LLM-based or agentic applications in production, preferably on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore Platform
Practical experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): chunking, embeddings, grounding and citation strategies.
Experience with prompt/instruction engineering and iterating on agent behavior against evaluation criteria.
Experience integrating agents with external systems via typed/schema-validated tool calls or function calling (MCP experience a strong plus).
Comfortable working across multiple agent codebases with shared conventions this role is expected to reuse platform patterns rather than rebuild them per agent.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS Bedrock Agents, Guardrails and Knowledge Bases specifically.
Familiarity with building or maintaining internal developer tooling (snippet libraries, MCP servers, IDE extensions)
Exposure to HR, ITSM, finance/AP or procurement domain workflows.



Email your updated profiles on shakambari.nayak@ltts.com
